name: DeskLink
description: Your DeskLink phone in the top bar, with everything it can do: how it is connected, battery, quick actions (send files, clipboard, ring, lock, screen, photo), what is going on now, and a section for each area (send, insert from the phone, sound, notes, notifications, calls, terminals, screen, files, privacy) with its switches. Its notifications appear as GNOME notifications, with replies, and a call ringing on it as a banner with Answer and Decline. On the lock screen it offers "Unlock with your phone" when you turned that on in DeskLink. Needs the DeskLink app.
